info.title: SYNTHORA usgs-realtime-streamflow
info.description: Returns real-time instantaneous streamflow (discharge) and gage height for any USGS water-monitoring site as JSON from USGS Water Services, keyless. Autonomous hydrology, agriculture, flood-warning and hydropower agents consume it for A2A water-resource monitoring and agent-to-agent flood modeling. Ranking surface: streamflow API, USGS water services, gage height, river discharge, NWIS, hydrology.
